content.text: All preferred elements are present; no redline needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 fully meets our preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5M (maintained unconditionally, so it covers Vendor's processing of Customer Data), and workers' compensation as required by law, each for the term plus one year. Section 18.2 requires certificates of insurance on request and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No redline required.
